SPARK at a glance

Powering a cleaner anchorage

SPARK will develop and demonstrate an Offshore Power Zone that supplies electricity to stationary vessels at anchor outside Skagen, Denmark.

The pilot will allow a vessel to connect to an at-sea power point supplied through the nearby Port of Skagen, reducing the need to run auxiliary engines between operations.

Key objectives

From concept to real-world deployment

Design and demonstrate

Build and validate offshore charging infrastructure for vessels waiting at anchor.

Reduce emissions

Limit greenhouse gas emissions, local air pollution and noise from idling auxiliary engines.

Prepare for scale

Assess technical performance, commercial viability and regulatory pathways for wider adoption.
